text:
incident-bot: Pager triggered -> P1 latency spike on hosted-inference/core. Alert rule: 99th token latency > 1200ms for 3m. Paging primary oncall.
ash.k: ACK — I'm primary, jumping in now. pulling logs.
priya.m: seeing elevated queue depth and KV cache miss spikes in eu-west-1. adding to thread.
mike.s: pinging infra for any ongoing maintenance? not seeing scheduled restarts.
jules: console shows autoscaler flapping for workers; scaling events every ~30s.
oncall-bot: Quick runbook pointer: follow `latency-spike-v2` -> https://runbooks.internal/latency-spike-v2 (check cache, scale, fallback model).
ash.k: running targeted query to count slow requests: `SELECT count(*) FROM request_logs WHERE latency_ms > 1200 AND ts > now() - interval '5 minutes'` — will paste when it returns.
incident-bot: Update: Pager acknowledged by ash.k.
priya.m: query result: ~1.2k requests in last 5m. KV cache miss rate ~78% on primary pool.
mike.s: I can try bumping cache TTL on the edge nodes and enable soft-serve fallback to smaller model to drop latency. suggestions?
jules: TTL bump might raise memory; do canary on 2 nodes first. fallback model route looks safe.
ash.k: doing canary patch on two inference pods now: ```kubectl patch deployment inf-worker -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"worker","env":[{"name":"CACHE_TTL","value":"60"}]}]}}}}'```
ash.k: canary applied, watching metrics.
ash.k: partial mitigation observed — 99th down from ~1.3s to ~700ms on canary nodes.
priya.m: queue-processor backlog still present, scaling up processors +3 replicas.
mike.s: scaling triggered, new pods initializing. tail logs show steady request drain.
ash.k: customer impact assessment: conversational endpoints seeing timeouts and degraded tail latency affecting ~2k requests over last 10m. no data loss.
jules: posting a short note to #customer-impact to keep PMs informed.
ash.k: posted: "Latency spike impacting generation endpoints in eu-west-1. Partial mitigation underway; canary improvements observed. Full region scaling in progress. Will update in 10m."
oncall-bot: Handoff note: primary -> ash.k (active). secondary -> priya.m (standby). If primary goes offline, secondary should escalate to infra-manager @maria.
sre-lead: Escalation rules reminder: escalate to leadership / oncall-ops if any of the following occur — error rate > 5% persistent for 10m, 99th > 2000ms for 10m, or customer-visible timeouts > 5% of requests.
priya.m: noted. standing by to take over.
ash.k: timeline update: canary success, scaling finishing, tail dropping to ~550ms across new pods. still watching for autoscaler churn. next step: tighten autoscaler thresholds and pin min replicas while we stabilize.
mike.s: applied temporary minReplicas=8 to avoid thrashing. monitoring for memory pressure.
jules: added a note to the runbook about autoscaler hysteresis tuning.
ash.k: if metrics regress to previous levels (99th > 2s or error rate spikes), we'll escalate per the rules above.
priya.m: I'm creating a ticket for postmortem and linking the runbook + this thread.
ash.k: thanks team — will keep updates in this thread every 5 minutes until we see stability. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident status: mitigation in-progress. Next automated check in 5m.
ash.k: update 5m — stable for 3m, 99th at ~520ms, error rate <1%. closing initial page but keeping the thread open for postmortem tasks.
